name: Rzeszów
queryAndRequestSummary: English and Polish first-party discovery were performed. The municipal BIP and Geoportal WFS were checked, followed by capabilities, schema, bounded geometry, and national ULDK requests. The local public WFS returned three parcel polygons and stable native IDs. Runtime qualification remains held.

routesAttempted.result: Official municipal Geodesy Department page; identifies cadastral/map materials and the municipal Geoportal at osrodek.erzeszow.pl.
HTTP 200; WFS 2.0.0, title EwMapa Map Server 15.15; exposes ewns:dzialki / Działki, default EPSG:2178, alternatives EPSG:2180, EPSG:3857, EPSG:4326, and a WGS84 bounding box covering Rzeszów.
HTTP 200; schema exposes ID_DZIALKI, parcel/administrative fields, DATA, and geometria as a GML surface.

HTTP 200; three parcel features returned with full GML polygons and native ID_DZIALKI values. The service interpreted the EPSG:4326 bbox in latitude,longitude order; this is recorded and requires adapter care.
HTTP 200 text response '-1 brak wyników' plus a malformed-XML notice; treated as an unresolved exact-point lookup, not absence evidence.

geometryAssessment.coverage: bounded service response verified; citywide coverage unverified

compositeKeyProvenance: The source-native ID_DZIALKI values are used unchanged. Their embedded unit/parcel structure is source provenance, not an internally generated row number.

registryAssessment.basis: Official Rzeszów municipal Geodesy Department and municipal Geoportal WFS provide local cadastral custodian/service evidence.
registryAssessment.limit: This does not establish complete citywide coverage or qualify a production adapter.

uncertainty: WFS axis order must be handled explicitly; the tested EPSG:4326 request used latitude,longitude bbox order.
The exact WUP point was preserved. The ULDK no-result response and any exact-point miss are not absence findings.
Only a three-feature bounded sample was retained; completeness, update cadence, and anonymous availability over time are unverified.
The service response includes source attributes beyond the safe allowlist; those were not retained in GeoJSON.
